name: What is the typical lifespan of rain gutters?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical lifespan of rain gutters?

acceptedAnswer.text: The lifespan of rain gutters varies significantly based on the material. Vinyl gutters may last 10-20 years, aluminum 20-30 years, and copper or steel gutters can last 50 years or more with proper maintenance. Regular cleaning and prompt repairs of minor damage are essential to extend their service life. Ignoring maintenance, especially in areas like DFW where debris from trees can accumulate quickly, will shorten the lifespan of any gutter system.
acceptedAnswer.description: Gutter lifespan depends on material, from 10-20 years for vinyl to 50+ for copper/steel. Regular maintenance, like cleaning, is vital to prolong life.
